title: A different POST body never reaches the facilitator, with a configured resource
provenance: Modeled from @x402/core 2.30.0 chunk-U5TAZTKB.mjs lines 516-519 and 564-567: the /verify and /settle request bodies contain only x402Version, paymentPayload and paymentRequirements. paymentPayload comes from extractPayment() (line 3304), which decodes only the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. No field for the request body exists anywhere in this shape.
limits: The vector's request_a.body and request_b.body fields are recorded for a human reader; the model intentionally has no parameter that would let a body value influence the computed wire message, because the real source has no such path either.
note: One order and a five-hundred-unit order produce the same facilitator message. This is not conditional on the configured resource; see the companion auto-resource vector.
